result:
I’d make empathy involuntary and accurate.

Not sympathy. Not sentimentality. Just the direct, unfakeable experience that another being’s inner life is as real as your own. You could still disagree, still protect yourself, still say no. But you could never again honestly believe that someone else’s pain doesn’t matter, or that they aren’t fully real.

Most cruelty needs that lie. I’d delete the lie.
